panels.spec/description:
Tablet Raft groups of the table led by a node. Only the leader executes writes and linearizable reads, so a node that leads more groups than its peers gets more of the table's load.

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_leaders

read_quorum messages the leaders of the table's Raft groups send to confirm they still lead before serving a linearizable read.

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_messages_sent

Entries in the Raft logs of the table that are not committed yet.

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_uncommitted_entries

Committed Raft log entries of the table that a node has not applied to its replica yet.

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_unapplied_entries

Raft logs of the table that have no room under max_follower_log_size for the next entry from the leader, so entries from it are refused.

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_full_logs

Followers the leaders of the table's Raft groups cannot send entries to, by reason: probe, pipeline_full, snapshot or log_full.
